text: Koperasi is an AI agent owned by a co-op of its members, on NEAR.
Who controls it? The members, one vote each. Its by-laws are locked by hash, and it obeys only the version they voted.
Don't trust us: your browser checks the by-laws hash, the contract's keys, and nineteen attacks refused on-chain.
The agent proposes changes to its own by-laws, and the members decide. When one proposal rested on a wrong average, they put the old terms back.
When the court suspended it, the members approved its recovery plan, and its share climbs back over thirty days.
A second worker runs as a Shade Agent, its key made inside a TEE and attested on-chain.
Co-ops form a federation, and the contract enforces its loan ceiling.
Members vote, share profit by rule, and pledge work to each other.
And every claim checks out, in one command.
